certificates.payment_methods: GCash (to Agnes Calapaan at 0997 742 8176) or Cash upon pickup
certificates.delivery_methods: Online Download (PDF in My Requests) or In-person Pickup at Parish Office

types.description: Official proof of Baptism administered at San Lorenzo Ruiz Parish.
requirements: Valid Government-issued ID of requester or authorized family member
PSA Birth Certificate of the child/person on the record
Complete Full Name, Birthday, Father's Name, Mother's Maiden Name
Year or Date of Baptism (if known)

types.description: Official proof of the Sacrament of Confirmation (Kumpil).
requirements: Valid Government ID
PSA Birth Certificate or copy of Baptismal Certificate
Confirmand's Full Name, Date/Year of Confirmation
Parents and Sponsor names

types.description: Proof of First Holy Communion reception.
requirements: Valid Government ID
Baptismal Certificate
Communicant's Full Name and Date/Year of First Communion

types.description: Official church certificate of Holy Matrimony solemnized at the parish.
requirements: Valid Government ID of either spouse
PSA Marriage Certificate or Marriage Contract (if available)
Husband's Full Name and Wife's Maiden Name
Date of Marriage

types.description: Parish record of funeral Mass and burial blessing.
requirements: Valid ID of the immediate relative / requester
PSA Death Certificate or Local Civil Registrar Death Certificate
Cemetery Burial Permit
Name of deceased and burial date

blessings.fee: No mandatory fixed fee; voluntary love offering for the officiating priest is welcome.
blessings.lead_time: Request at least 3 to 5 days in advance for priest availability.

types.description: Blessing of a newly built, renovated, or occupied family home.
requirements: Requester Full Name and contact phone number
Complete house address and landmarks / directions
Preferred ceremony date and time
Presence of family members during the blessing

types.description: Blessing of a car, motorcycle, van, or commercial vehicle.
requirements: Owner Full Name and contact number
Vehicle Type, Make/Model, Plate / Conduction Number
Preferred date and time (usually done at church premises or owner residence)

types.description: Blessing of a store, office, clinic, or business establishment.
requirements: Owner / Manager Full Name and business name
Exact commercial address and contact details
Preferred ceremony date and time

services.schedule: Sundays after Mass or scheduled Saturday community baptisms
requirements: PSA Birth Certificate of the child
Parents' Catholic Marriage Certificate (if married in Catholic Church)
At least two Catholic Godparents / Sponsors (Ninong & Ninang) who are confirmed Catholics
Pre-Baptismal Seminar attendance for parents and godparents
Valid IDs of parents

services.schedule: Annual Parish Confirmation Rite or Archdiocesan scheduled visitation
requirements: Baptismal Certificate with annotation 'For Confirmation Purposes'
PSA Birth Certificate
Must have received First Holy Communion
Confirmation Catechesis seminar completion
One Catholic sponsor (Ninong or Ninang)

services.schedule: Scheduled with Parish Office at least 1 to 3 months prior to wedding date
requirements: PSA Birth Certificate (Bride & Groom)
PSA CENOMAR (Certificate of No Marriage Record - valid within 6 months)
Baptismal Certificate with annotation 'FOR MARRIAGE PURPOSES' (valid within 6 months)
Confirmation Certificate with annotation 'FOR MARRIAGE PURPOSES'
Pre-Cana / Marriage Preparation Seminar Certificate
Canonical Interview with the Parish Priest
Marriage License from Local Civil Registrar (or PSA Marriage Contract if civilly married)
Parish Banns publication (3 consecutive Sundays)

services.schedule: Coordinated with parish office; emergency calls accepted 24/7
requirements: PSA Death Certificate or Civil Registrar Death Certificate
Burial Permit from the Municipal Cemetery / Memorial Park
Deceased person's full name, date of death, date of burial
Immediate relative contact information
Call Parish Emergency Hotline: 0997 742 8176 immediately
Patient name, hospital / home address, contact person on site
No advance paperwork required; priest dispatched directly for visitation
